title: RegenerateX
description: Modern high performance arena regeneration plugin for Paper and Purpur with voting GUI async regeneration FAWE and smooth lag free resets.
body:
# RegenerateX
 is a modern arena regeneration plugin for Paper and Purpur 1.21.1 built for practice PvP minigame and event servers. The plugin allows admins to create and save arena regions using a simple wand setup system while players can vote for arena regeneration using easy commands and GUI menus.

The plugin includes automatic arena resets configurable timers bossbar countdowns actionbar messages sounds particles and safe player teleportation before regeneration starts. RegenerateX is heavily optimized using async systems chunk batching gradual block placement and FAWE support to prevent TPS drops lag spikes or server freezing even with very large arenas.

# Commands:

* /rg create <arena>
* /rg wand
* /rg save <arena>
* /rg gui
* /rg reload
* /rg force <arena>
* /reg vote <arena>
* /reg menu
* /reg status

# Permissions:

* regeneratex.admin
* regeneratex.setup
* regeneratex.reload
* regeneratex.force
* regeneratex.vote
* regeneratex.menu
* regeneratex.status
* regeneratex.notify

# Features:

* Unlimited arenas
* Player voting system
* Modern GUIs
* Automatic regeneration timers
* PlaceholderAPI support
* LuckPerms support
* FAWE support
* Async regeneration
* Multi arena support
* Smooth lag free performance
